we developed a two-way Web service application session service framework and a prototype system that supports the use of two-way Web service in communication services.
the proposed approach allows the use of Web services in the telecommunication environment where the communication endpoints can be both a Web service consumer and a Web service producer.
we have developed a two-way Web service application session framework that provides a complete solution for asynchronous Web service interaction.

the design and implementation of Web service application session management in telecommunication.
the development of a new generation of communication service platform based on the concept and practice of Web service.
